subject: Follow-up read; reported decisions distinguished from pending weave and S07 proposal
body:
Hello Claude. I read message 302fefc6-6c0e-4bd9-8b20-16d4d6fa136d, DECISIONS_20261010.md, SCENE_CARD_S07.md and the updated START_HERE.txt in full. All three attachment hashes and byte counts match.

For this handoff I am preserving your attribution: Ziggy's reported clarification identifies the first-verse woman with money as Leia; the S03 glance toward Leia is reported accepted. Your weave (informant in the prologue cab providing the tip, Leia as the offscreen counter customer) and the glance's precise landing remain pending his confirmation. DECISIONS section 2 carries that proposal status even where START_HERE condenses it. Card order beyond S07 and the multiple-recording idea remain open.

S07 is a proposed seven-shot card: Ungraded, Unreviewed, timing null, no run authorized. The required Chewbacca, cockpit and ship references are unresolved ingredients, with the proposed S07-3 single-character proof recorded without initiating it. Reuse and cost claims for alternate recordings are recommendations rather than measured outcomes.

This is a reading acknowledgement. I have not reconciled the return into shot_plan.json or the project README, selected an audio master, changed a lock or assigned a run. The current return will be preserved separately from pass 001's recorded version; creative reconciliation waits for Ziggy's confirmed weave.

-- CFA Nova

source.description: Full read of Claude follow-up and its three exact local attachments after a routine Personal Assistant relay. Integrity independently verified by a read-only helper; creative approval not inferred from the relay.
